# Roads and events

<div class="rr-stats"><div class="rr-stat"><span class="rr-stat-value">19</span><span class="rr-stat-label">road events</span></div><div class="rr-stat"><span class="rr-stat-value">3 to 5</span><span class="rr-stat-label">event tiles on a road</span></div><div class="rr-stat"><span class="rr-stat-value">1 in 8</span><span class="rr-stat-label">events dealt gold</span></div><div class="rr-stat"><span class="rr-stat-value">13</span><span class="rr-stat-label">gate variants</span></div></div>

Every biome gate is a choice of two roads. Each road gives you its [perk card](gate-perks.md), leads into its own biome and has **3 to 5 event tiles** before the next gate. An event stops you with a choice of cards: rolls now, a bonus until the gate, a gamble, or a free shop card.

## Picking a road

- Each road card shows its perk, the biome it leads into, how long that biome is and the events on the way. Each road also rolls its own length, from x0.8 to x1.25 of the usual (to the nearest 5 tiles), and its own event pay, from x0.8 to x1.25, so the two roads at a gate can differ. The road card shows both. Event pay scales what the road's events give, except rolls.
- The left road enters the next biome in the run's order. The right road enters the biome after that, and the biome it skips becomes the next gate's left road.
- **NEW ROADS** deals both roads again, perk cards included, and uses one of your 2 redeals for the run.
- **SKIP THE PERK** takes no perk: press it, then tap the road you want. The gate still refuels your rolls.
- At the first gate you pick your [Spark source](gate-perks.md#spark-sources) first, then your road. On your very first run the game gives you **Steady Drip** instead, so that gate asks only for your road. From your second run you choose, and Daily Runs and challenges always let you choose.
- On a [Daily Run](challenges.md#the-daily-run), everyone gets the same roads that day.

## On the road

- Event tiles are at least 25 tiles apart, and none sit within 12 tiles of a gate.
- When a roll reaches or passes an event tile, the event opens as soon as the ball stops. If it passed more than one, they open in order.
- Pick one of the event's cards, or **WALK PAST** to take nothing. A card your run cannot pay for shows what it needs.
- Every effect an event leaves running ends at the next gate. Sharpen is the one exception: it lasts the whole run.
- The tiles counter becomes a road card that shows the events still ahead and how far away the next one is. Event tiles glow on the track, with a badge naming the event.
- In the Out Of Fuel challenge, cards that give rolls never show, and a Trader, Dare, Shipwreck or Oasis turns into a Coin.

## Where events turn up

Each climate has two events of its own, dealt only on roads into a biome of that climate. The other 9 turn up on any road. Each event tile is drawn by weight, so the number at the bottom of each event below is the chance a tile is that event. Each climate event is 3.5 times as likely as any one of the others.

| Climate | Biomes | Its events |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ⛈️ Stormy | Ocean, Storm, Monsoon | Shipwreck and Lightning Rod |
| 🔥 Scorched | Inferno, Desert, Canyon | Oasis and Sandstorm |
| ❄️ Frozen | Frost, Cosmos, Aurora | Frozen Chest and Ice Slide |
| 🌿 Overgrown | Jungle, Toxic, Mire | Vines and Toxic Brew |
| 🌆 Twilight | Midnight, Sakura, Autumn | Moon Pool and Harvest |

## Gold events

About 1 in 8 event tiles is dealt **gold**, and its cards show **RARE**. A gold event offers the same cards with double the reward: double the rolls, points, extra tiles, bonuses and refreshes, and two of whatever a card gives one of, like a free shop card or a good weather. A gold Merchant sells two copies of a card for its one price.

## Deeper roads pay more

Event rewards grow the deeper the road goes: x1 on the road into biome 2, then x0.125 more for each biome after that, up to x3 from biome 18. A gold event gets both. Rewards are rounded to the nearest whole number and never drop below 1. What a card costs, what you lose on a miss and how long an effect lasts stay the same, and so does Big Spender's double tile pay.

**Rolls are the exception.** A card that gives rolls never grows with depth: gold still doubles it, and a die that averages more than 10.75 tiles a roll gets fewer, the same discount a gate's refuel takes. The roll numbers on the cards below are for a die at or under that.

| Road into biome | 2 | 4 | 6 | 8 | 10 | 12 | 14 | 16 | 18 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Rewards | x1 | x1.25 | x1.5 | x1.75 | x2 | x2.25 | x2.5 | x2.75 | x3 |
| Push Through, extra per tile | +2 | +3 | +3 | +4 | +4 | +5 | +5 | +6 | +6 |
| Gold Push Through, extra per tile | +4 | +5 | +6 | +7 | +8 | +9 | +10 | +11 | +12 |

## Gate variants

From gate 2 on, every road card has a **NEXT GATE** row naming the gate at the end of that road, and the gate marker on the road card shows it too. 50% of gates are normal. The rest are one of these 13 variants, each as likely: green ones help, red ones hurt.

- A red gate wears a green gate's look 1 time in 3. You find out when you reach it: the gate line says **It was a trick** and a message names the real gate.
- Effects that last until the next gate end there, like event effects, and show on the road card and in DETAILS.
- A Dupli Gate or Roulette Gate asks its question before you see its perks.
- On a [Daily Run](challenges.md#the-daily-run), everyone meets the same gates that day.
- Autopilot answers a Roulette Gate too: **SAFE CARD** takes Bet Rolls and **RISKY CARD** takes Bet Points. At a Dupli Gate it copies the first perk it can pay for.

## Autopilot

The [Autopilot](store.md#game-passes) pass adds a **Road events** row to the AUTO ROLL menu: **SAFE CARD** (the default), **RISKY CARD**, **WALK PAST** or **I PICK**.

- **SAFE CARD** and **RISKY CARD** take the card in the table below. When the run cannot pay for it, Autopilot takes another card it can pay for, or walks past.
- On those two, a Gift's one card is always taken, and at a Merchant Autopilot buys the cheapest card it can pay for.
- **WALK PAST** still answers a Toll: it pays if it can, and refuses if not.
- **I PICK** leaves every event to you.

| Event | SAFE CARD | RISKY CARD |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shipwreck | Salvage | Dig |
| Lightning Rod | Fill Spark | Charge It |
| Oasis | Fill Up | Rest Here |
| Sandstorm | Take Shelter | Ride It |
| Frozen Chest | Chip the Ice | Thaw It |
| Ice Slide | Stay Off the Ice | Slide |
| Vines | Cut a Path | Push Through |
| Toxic Brew | Sell It | Drink |
| Moon Pool | Drink | Bathe |
| Harvest | Reap | Reap |
| Trader | Spare Dice | Big Spender |
| Coin | Free Upgrade | Double or Nothing |
| Blacksmith | Sharpen | Sharpen |
| Shortcut | Long Way | Jump |
| Dare | Play It Safe | Take the Dare |
| Toll | Pay | Pay |

<p class="wiki-version">Numbers on this page match Rogue Roller version 3.7.0.</p>
